topics.topic: Whether a connections file may reside in its connection photo folder and how its mandatory opening is handled
questions: May the connections file be located inside the connection's photo folder; and if it may, is its mandatory opening exempt from the recorded openings, or must such a location be rejected?

quotes:
Each scan, placement and mark reads the connections file exactly once, at its connection check,
   and uses that reading for the whole operation.

- INV-10: scan, placement and mark each answer the CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIRMED member of = models.RefusalCode for an unconfirmed connection; with every opening of the photo folder of that connection and of a file in it recorded, none is recorded, and no stored image, placement record or mark record is written (`test_an_unconfirmed_connection_delivers_nothing`).
judgement.why: The required connections-file read is itself a recorded opening of a file in the photo folder when the unrestricted connections_file setting points there, while the Required tests passage requires that recorder to observe no such opening.

bases.rests_on:
A change of the root or of a subfolder clears the confirmation,
and delivery stops until the owner confirms again.

unsupported_sides:
Each scan, placement and mark reads the connections file exactly once, at its connection check,
   and uses that reading for the whole operation.

witness.initial: The required connections_file run setting names a valid connections file inside the photo folder of a project whose record is unconfirmed.
events: The calling flow of the owner makes an authenticated scan request for that project.
The service reaches the connection check and reads the connections file.
outcomes: A5 rule 7 requires the service to open and read the connections file exactly once, so the recorder observes an opening of a file in the photo folder.
The INV-10 Required tests passage requires the recorder to observe no opening of the photo folder or of a file in it.
basis: There is one principal: the calling flow of the owner. It may act on every confirmed connection.

An
   operation on a project with no connection is refused with the UNKNOWN_PROJECT member of = models.RefusalCode, and one with an
   unconfirmed connection with the CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIRMED member of = models.RefusalCode. This is decided by the service, not by
   the caller.

provenance.quote: A change of the root or of a subfolder clears the confirmation, and delivery stops until the owner confirms again.

topics.topic: Whether the test must verify that all pre-existing stored records remain unchanged and undeleted
questions: Must this test also prove that every pre-existing stored image, placement record and mark record remains unchanged and is not deleted, or does it prohibit only writing a new or replacement record?

quotes: - INV-10: scan, placement and mark each answer the CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIRMED member of = models.RefusalCode for an unconfirmed connection; with every opening of the photo folder of that connection and of a file in it recorded, none is recorded, and no stored image, placement record or mark record is written (`test_an_unconfirmed_connection_delivers_nothing`).

The installation creates the binary
   store and the state folder; the service creates only folders below them, with the imported
   `STORE_FOLDER_MODE` and `STATE_FOLDER_MODE` constants, and removes none.
judgement.why: The Required tests item prohibits writing stored images and records, while A6 independently prohibits the service from removing any of them, so the proposed cleanup behavior is not allowed.
